title: OpenCV and Computer Vision Workshop
summary: Building a Face Recognition based Attendence System with Vaanya Sharma
description: Led by the Professional Event Director, Vaanya Sharma, participants used Python and Google Collab for coding; OpenCV for image processing and webcam access; pre-trained face detection models and CSV files to store attendence records.

title: Build Your Own PCB
summary: Learning how to build a PCB with Adhyayan Tiwari
description: Participants learnt how to circuit schematic from scratch; select components and design connections; design their PCB layout and route connections and run design checks and prepare their PCB for manufacturing

title: Karaoke with SASE
summary: Celebrating the end of midterm season with karaoke, arts and crafts, and food!
description: A lot of singing was done alongside a raffle/giveaway for the karaoke winner. Indian food and art and crafts were indulged in and the participants also got a sneak peak of upcoming workshops and professional development panels.

title: Big Little Program Launch
description: Bigs and littles were introduced to eachother based on their current major/interests such as engineering, medicine, healthcare, software development, cybersecurity, and applied trades, etc. Big and littles had icebreakers and won prizes at the launch!

title: Projects Team Launch
summary: The project teams launch where the 5 projects teams are introduced to eachother!
description: Mmembers got to know what project they were assigned to and what the project entails. They also got to meet their project team members and learn about the upcoming events for the semester. Kickoff bingo was played with the winner getting a free 2026 STEMCONNECT Conference ticket

media.alt: project team members having their weekly meeting

title: SASE Kickoff
summary: Get introduced to SASE, meet their officers, and learn about the upcoming events for the semester!
description: Participants got to meet the SASE officers and learn about the upcoming events for the semester. They also got to enjoy free food and drinks, play icebreaker games, and were informed of programs like Big Little, Project Teams, and Professional Development Panels.
